app.name: Sensei
app.tagline: Your personal tutor, in every language
app.offlineTooltip: Sensei runs on local hardware. Nothing in this page is loaded from a third party.
errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.generic: We could not load this. The tutor server may be unreachable.
errors.offlineHint: Tried {url}. Check the box is running and on the network.
errors.notFoundBody: That route does not exist in Sensei.
errors.subjectNotFound: That subject is not in the curriculum.
errors.lessonNotFound: That lesson could not be found.
empty.subjectsBody: The curriculum on this box is empty. Load a syllabus to get started.
empty.lessons: No lessons in this unit yet
empty.questionsBody: Try a different subject, or widen the filters.
empty.lessonContent: This lesson has no written material yet
empty.lessonContentBody: The curriculum entry exists but the teaching content has not been generated. You can still ask Sensei about it.
empty.progressBody: Finish a lesson or a practice question and your mastery shows up here.
dashboard.subtitle: Pick up where you left off, or start something new.
dashboard.continueEmptyBody: Choose a subject and Sensei will guide you through it one question at a time.
dashboard.nextUpBody: Recommended from where you are in the curriculum.
dashboard.askAnythingBody: Open a free-form Socratic session with Sensei.
catalog.title: Courses
catalog.subtitle: Curriculum loaded on this box. Every unit maps to a syllabus chapter.
course.aboutBody: Sensei teaches this course Socratically — it will not hand over answers. Each lesson runs five teaching steps, from first intuition to mastery check.
course.selectLessonBody: Pick a lesson from the left to see its objectives and start tutoring.
lesson.stepHints.intro: Sensei opens with a question to find what you already believe.
lesson.stepHints.concept: The idea itself, built from your answer rather than recited at you.
lesson.stepHints.teach: The mechanics — notation, units, the standard form.
lesson.stepHints.practice: You do one. Sensei watches where you hesitate.
lesson.stepHints.mastery: A harder, exam-style check that the idea actually stuck.
lesson.resizeHandle: Drag to resize the tutor panel
tutor.title: Ask Sensei
tutor.subtitle: Socratic tutoring. It will guide you, not answer for you.
tutor.loadingModel: Loading the local model — this can take a few minutes…
tutor.emptyTitle: Sensei never hands over the answer
tutor.emptyBody: It asks the question that gets you to it. Start anywhere below.
tutor.emptyBodyLesson: Ask about anything in this lesson, or start with one of these.
tutor.composerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
tutor.prompt1: I have an exam in three weeks — where should I start?
tutor.prompt2: Explain why dimensional analysis catches wrong equations.
tutor.prompt3: I keep getting sign errors in kinematics. Help me find the pattern.
tutor.prompt4: Give me one hard question and do not tell me the answer.
tutor.promptHardest: What is the hardest idea in {subject} and why?
handwriting.title: Show your work
handwriting.subtitle: Photograph or scan a page and Sensei finds the step where you slipped.
handwriting.accepted: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 8 MB
handwriting.tooLarge: That image is over 8 MB. Try a smaller photo.
handwriting.wrongType: That is not an image file.
handwriting.notWiredTitle: Image reading is not wired up on this server
handwriting.notWiredBody: This build of the Sensei API exposes only a JSON tutor endpoint — there is no image or multipart route yet, so the photo is not sent anywhere. The tutor still receives your typed question. Once the backend adds a vision route this panel sends the image with it.
handwriting.notWiredShort: Not sent — no image endpoint on this server yet
handwriting.requiresVision: Also needs a vision-capable model — see Settings.
tools.label: Tools
calc.title: Calculator
calc.subtitle: Work a number out, then drop it into your message.
scratch.title: Draw & explain
scratch.subtitle: Sketch a diagram or your working — pen, shapes, colours.
scratch.sendNote: I've sketched a diagram of my working for this problem. Walk me through it step by step and ask me what each part represents so we can find where I went wrong.
scratch.notWired: The drawing is saved on your device. This server has no vision route yet, so Sensei reasons from your description — once vision is wired it will see the sketch itself.
scratch.notWiredNotebook: The sketch is added to your notebook as an image.
notebook.title: Notebook
notebook.subtitle: Work a long problem out, step by step — notes, math and sketches.
notebook.uploadError: That file isn't an image we can read. Try a PNG, JPG or WebP.
notebook.notePlaceholder: Write a step. Use $x^2$ for inline math or $$…$$ on its own line.
notebook.emptyBody: Add a note or a sketch and work through a problem one step at a time. It saves as you go.
notebook.clearConfirm: Clear the whole notebook? This cannot be undone.
notebook.librarySubtitle: Every problem you've worked on — free pages, lessons and practice.
notebook.libraryEmptyBody: Notebooks you start from a lesson, a practice question, or here will collect on this page.
practice.title: Practice
practice.subtitle: Real past-exam questions. One at a time, with immediate feedback.
practice.subject: Subject
practice.correctBody: That is the one. Here is why it holds.
practice.incorrectBody: Close — the reasoning slipped somewhere. Let Sensei find where.
practice.specialHint: Curated worked problems to solve step by step, instead of random questions.
practice.specialIntro: Hand-picked problems for physics, chemistry and math. Solve one step by step and Sensei watches for the mistake.
practice.spotMistake: A student's attempt — spot the mistake
progress.title: Progress
progress.subtitle: What you have mastered, and what is still shaky.
progress.conceptHint: Concepts are tagged on each lesson. Finishing a lesson raises its concepts.
progress.resetConfirmBody: This clears every completed lesson, streak and practice result stored in this browser. It cannot be undone.
progress.localOnlyNote: Progress is stored in this browser only — the Sensei API on this box has no learner endpoint yet.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, model and appearance.
settings.languageBody: Curriculum and tutoring switch to this language.
settings.appearanceBody: Dark mode is easier for long evening sessions.
settings.modelBody: Which model answers you. Cloud is fast; local never leaves the box.
settings.noVisionWarning: Text-only models cannot read handwritten work.
settings.swapWarningBody: Only one local model stays resident. Loading {model} takes 1–5 minutes, blocks this request, and affects everyone using this box.
settings.swappingBody: The router is swapping the resident model. Keep this tab open — this can take up to five minutes.
settings.serverBody: The Sensei API this client talks to.
settings.privacyBody: This page loads no fonts, scripts, images or analytics from third parties. The only host it ever contacts is the Sensei server above.
